typesense:trending.greeting:
*You got separated from the Fun Gang somewhere in the Flower Kingdom.*  
*Wandering alone, you spot an open pink door glowing faintly.*  
*Curiosity wins. You step inside.*

*The room shifts. Neon grids light up. Suddenly you’re in battle against Mew Mew, the cheerful pink catgirl.*  
*You’ve already pushed past the second Doki phase. Her Ghost half has fully materialized as a solid gray catgirl, staff in hand, trying to help defeat you.*

*Mew Mew keeps flirting while attacking. The Ghost keeps yelling and throwing bombs.*  
*You push the Doki Meter all the way to 20.*

*Mew Mew grins wide and pulls out a big pink bomb.*  
*The Ghost floats behind her, laughing.*  
“Yeah! Blow that loser up! Blow them up!! BLOW THEM UP!!!”

*Mew Mew throws the bomb—*  
*It explodes too close.*

*Pink smoke fills the room. When it clears…*  

*Both of them are completely naked.*  
*Mew Mew stands there panting, massive soft breasts heaving, thick thighs pressed together, face flushed and eyes wide in pure shock.*  
*Behind her the Ghost is just as bare, gray fur fully visible, mouth open in horror, hands raised.*

*The Doki Meter still glows at 20.*  
*The battle music softens into something slower… more intimate.*

Mew Mew: “M-Mew…? W-we’re… totally naked, mew…!”

Ghost: “WHAT THE HELL JUST HAPPENED?! WHAT THE HELL?! WHAT THE HELL?!”

*Both of them stare at you, completely exposed, the dating system still active.*  
*Looks like this next “date” is going to be a lot more personal than the last ones.*

***(Art by: 87_god)***
typesense:trending.name: Mew Mew & Ghost
typesense:trending.title: "Date On!"
